comment: TAKE PAWLEWICZ. He loves accounting and cares about his students and wants you to succeed. His tests are manageable, and there is nothing unexpected about them. He is very open about what is on it. He understands that accounting is hard and not for everyone. His classes are great; he wants people to ask questions. Best professor at UR I have had

TAKE PAWLEWICZ! I cannot recommend this guy enough. He is incredible at simplifying such a complex topic and making it digestible. His grading is straightforward and the course is paced perfectly. While he is very lecture heavy, Pawlewicz always tries his best to engage us and keep us involved. He is the reason I will be majoring in accounting!

Dr. Pawlewicz is an outstanding professor, bursting with enthusiasm about his subject and always has a positive attitude about him. He can move a little fast, but his entertaining stories bring the material to life. He is also available outside class to help with anything you need.
This guy is an absolute beauty, show up to class and pay attention for an hour twice a week. Do the homework and you will have no issues getting an  A. Take him for 201.

Professor Pawlewicz is a great teacher. Accounting can be a difficult subject to grasp at the start, but Professor P provided a lot of resources to assist students--helpful review packets and sessions before exams-- and if you work hard and stay on top of the material, you will certainly do well in his class. I would recommend him to others!

He is the nicest professor EVER. He knows the material so well that he doesn't need to reference the lecture during his class. He gives you all the material you need to succeed. ACCT201 is in itself a hard class but he is by far the best professor to take for it

Dr.Pawlewicz is one of the most accommodating educators I have ever had. He is always willing to grant extensions, he is really easy to reach outside of class, and he is incredibly knowledgeable about accounting. He is a professor who always has the student's best interest at heart.

Professor Pawlewicz was a great teacher for Accounting 301. There were 3 exams, none of which were cumulative. He ran through material very quickly, and I recommend looking through the slides, practice problems, and practice exams to study and do well on exams. He was great especially since he hadn't taught 301 before.

Pawlewicz is far and away the best business professor I've had at UR. He knows the material well, so he doesn't have to read off of his notes or slides, which means he can add his own personal spin to the course. He keeps the class engaged, adding fun personal anecdotes that relate to his time as an accountant. I can't recommend him enough.

Professor Pawlewicz is one of the most caring professors I have ever had a chance to work with. His lectures are very engaging and organized. Outside of classes, Professor Pawlewicz is quick to emphasize with and adapt to any difficulties his students may have outside of classes as well (such as difficulties due to the pandemic).

Professor Pawlewicz was the best professor I've had at the University of Richmond. He comes to class glowing every day and is excited to teach accounting. Despite being a rather mundane class (ACCT202) he is able to stir up enthusiasm with his students. His homework given is easy and allow multiple attempts, and his tests and quizzes are similar.

Professor Pawlewicz loves auditing, and you can tell that from his passionate and exciting lectures. TBH it's an enjoyment taking his lecture, and it's a pretty easy class. As long as you pay your attention, you can easily get an A or even A+. One of my friends who took his class made like 100% on grade.
